artifacts.title: Session authority to raise supermajority voting threshold for officers

matches.evidence: A Session cannot raise the voting requirement beyond a majority for calling a pastor, dissolving a pastoral relation, or electing a church officer.

artifacts.title: Election procedures for pastor, associate pastor, and officers

matches.evidence: Proposed amendments to BCO 20-4, 24-3, and 24-4 regarding election of pastor, associate pastor, and officers were found not in conflict with the Constitution.
